questions: Do you have a tremor that occurs when your hands are at rest?
Have you noticed that your movements have become slower?
Do you feel stiffness in your muscles?
Have you noticed a change in your handwriting, such as it becoming smaller?
Have you experienced any balance problems or frequent falls?
Are you taking any medications that might cause these symptoms, such as antipsychotics or certain nausea medications?
Do you have any problems with your blood pressure or bladder control?
Do you have any difficulty looking up or down?
Is the tremor more prominent on one side of your body than the other?
Have you noticed a decrease in your sense of smell?
Have you noticed that you blink less frequently?
Do you have a history of REM sleep behavior disorder, such as acting out your dreams?
